summary: Computed ESC(p) (word census col 4, C code, ESC(5)=6 checked) to 3e6 and min/quantile/median of ESC/log^2 p and U/log^2 p over dyadic windows [X,2X). For X>=1e5 the ESC minimum is flat at 0.10-0.11 (X=1e5..1e6) with min/median 0.16-0.18 is below U's (0.25), so ESC is not the cleaner lower-bound calibration. The ESC median drifts down (0.70 to 0.60 over 1e3-2e6), a crude fit gives ESC ~ (log p)^1.8 vs U ~ (log p)^2.7, so log^2 is the wrong normalisation for ESC.
not_done: ESC beyond 3e6 (needs the Z0779 engine); U beyond 2e5 (no U data, not recomputed); no formal extreme-value fit.
next: Re-fit ESC/log^a p with a free exponent and check min/median stability at 1e7 with the Z0779 engine.

summary: Wrote scripts/z52d_p2_NC0_Z0779.c (uint8 saturating I3/R/Uv counters; dyadic stats for p=1 mod 4) and ran it to N=1e8 in 147 s (1.87e10 triples, ~1.3e8 triples/s; triple count fits 0.56 N ln^2 N at 3e6, 3e7, 1e8). The R=0 primes it finds reproduce the known (*)-failure list (5569, 9601, 23929, 83449, 102001, 329617, 712321, cf. BM_CORRECTED_COUNT.md:193); 25 888 cells reach the 255 cap (upper tails only). N=1e10 needs ~2.9e12 triples (~6-7 CPU-h single core) and ~30 GB without segmentation, beyond the cap.
not_done: The brief's segmented sieve was NOT written: segmenting over n needs per-(t,u) state (~N ln N pairs), so I ran the non-segmented version (3 bytes per n). 1e10 not run; only window statistics exported, not per-n counts.
next: Write the bucketed segmented sieve, or run N=1e9 (3 GB, ~30-50 min) as the first real scale point.

summary: Counted all 3.06e6 Cremona elliptic curves with conductor <= 5e5 (allcurves files, github JohnCremona/ecdata; downloaded to /tmp, not in repo) and correlated #curves of conductor p, 2p, 4p, 8p, 16p with the U(p) residual over 1600 primes p=1 mod 4, p<=3e4. Raw Spearman for N=p is +0.087 (p=5e-4) but disappears after residualising the count on (1, log p, loglog p) (+0.048, p=0.057); all 2^k p give |rho|<=0.04 and p-values >0.1. Controls N=3p (rho=-0.23) and N=p+2 (rho=-0.18) are stronger than any ES-natural conductor, so no ES-specific signal.
not_done: Mordell-Weil ranks and any fibre-level identification with an ES genus-1 fibration (GEOMETRY_ES.md) not tested; only curve counts.
next: Use the rank column of allcurves at conductor p against the Mordell-Weil rank of an explicit ES genus-1 fibration, if one is written down.

summary: Exact divisor-form counter (scripts/z52d_p2_NC0_Z0896.c: (d-cy)(cz+d)=d^2 with c=4x-p, d=px; brute-force check on p<=37 passes) gives S(p)=#{x<=y, z<=p^2} for all 8977 primes p=1 mod 4 up to 2e5, with S(p)>=1 always. Regressing log(S+1) on (1, log p, loglog p, alpha*log L_Q(chi_p)) gives alpha=+0.33 (R^2-gain 0.42, Q=31), while the ES count U gives alpha=-0.30 (R^2-gain 0.49): the signed count follows the chi_p law with opposite sign. Residuals of S and U are anticorrelated (Spearman -0.59 after growth removal, -0.34 after the chi_31 adjustment, p~3e-247).
not_done: Only the z<=p^2 cap was run (no p^1.5 or p^3 caps); no mod-8 split; no chi_{-p} twist beyond the lfit-style regressors; the -0.59 residual correlation not decomposed. Note: the first run overflowed 64-bit at p*x>4e9 (fixed with __int128; reported numbers are from the fixed run).
next: Vary the z-cap (p^1.5, p^3) and split by p mod 8 to see whether the opposite-sign chi_p law and the residual anticorrelation survive.

summary: Type number of the maximal order of B_{p,inf} equals (S+s1)/2 with S=h(B_{p,inf})=(p-1)/12+(1/3)(1-(-3/p)) and s1=#F_p-rational supersingular j; s1=h(-4p)/2 was checked by direct point counts (a_p(E_j)=0) for all 147 primes p=1 mod 4 up to 2000 (0 mismatches), so T(p)=(S+h(-4p)/2)/2 (h(-4p) to 2e5 via scripts/z52d_p2_NC0_Z0917_h.c). The U-residual vs h(-4p)-residual Spearman is +0.142 (p~1e-41), the same L-function regressor already recorded in data/z52b/lfit.json: "U|-4p|Q=5": {"alpha": 0.101, "R2_gain": 0.018}.
not_done: Type numbers themselves are not correlated separately from h(-4p) (T differs by S/2, which is growth); no p>2e5.
next: None needed: the correction term is the L(1,chi_{-4p}) signal already in lfit.json.

summary: Partial Spearman of the U-residual (8966 primes p=1 mod 4, p<=2e5) with ord_p(10)/(p-1), given (2/p),(5/p): +0.135 (p~8e-38; 200 shuffled nulls sd 0.01). Given all 15 quadratic symbols (q/p), q<=47, it is still +0.068 (p~1e-10), so the signal is not carried by quadratic characters. The U-residual is much lower where 10 has index 8 in (Z/p)^* (mean -0.20, 273 primes; index 6: -0.088; index 1: +0.038), pointing at higher power-residue structure of 10; the same partial for ord_p(3) is +0.36 given (2/p),(5/p) and needs the same controls.
not_done: Quartic/octic power-residue symbols of 10 and mod-840 class fixed effects not included; U-residual uses only the lfit-style characters (Q<=1000), so part of the signal may be unmodelled character structure; ord_p(2), ord_p(3) only as a family check.
next: Add mod-840 fixed effects and quartic/octic residue symbols of 10 (and 3) as controls; if partial >=0.05 survives, write it up as a higher-character signature (FRONTIER 2.1).

summary: Searched polynomial identities for n(k)=mk+r (m<=12, x,y linear with |coeff|<=3, z forced to be a polynomial): exactly two families, 4/(3k+2) = 1/(k+1)+1/(3k+2)+1/((k+1)(3k+2)) and 4/(4k+3) = 1/(2k+2)+1/(2k+2)+1/((4k+3)(k+1)), both verified symbolically. Resultants in k across different progressions are not meaningful, so the two families were compared at a common n: the denominator-coincidence equations have no root n>1 (pairs tested: 1), so they never share a denominator.
not_done: Quadratic x,y (or rational-coefficient) ansatz not searched, so only two families; no pair on a common progression exists in this search.
next: Widen the ansatz to quadratic x,y to obtain >=10 families and compute common-n coincidences for all pairs.

summary: Enumerated all ES solutions x<=y<=z for the 211 primes p=1 mod 4 up to 3000 (scripts/z52d_p2_NC0_Z1013.c; counts match U in the f4 data for all 211) and the heights H=max(|num|,|den|) of the reduced ratios. max H(y/z) grows like p^1.94, max H(x/z) like p^2.87, and every one of the 8334 solutions' y/z is reconstructible from residues mod p^4 (2H^2<p^4), 31.6% from mod p^2. The height bound only fixes the modulus (about p^4); reconstructing from modular solutions still needs the modular solutions themselves.
not_done: Actual modular lifting (solve mod m for one p, CRT-lift, first-hit reconstruction) not implemented; this is the height/modulus test only.
next: Implement CRT lifting for p=409 up to modulus 2H^2+1 (~1e10) and test first-hit reconstruction.

summary: The move list was not in the repo, so I used the composition law of COMPOSITION_ES.md (Lemma 1.1, Prop 1.2: alpha=x+y*sqrt(f), N(alpha)=-D, odd products with D1..Dr | mu). V_n points at fixed mu are sparse: for n in {5,13,17,29,409,1009} and mu up to sqrt(n)+3000 there are at most 4 per mu (18 mu-values for n=409, A<=400), and in the scanned mu (>=6 divisors, A<=1200) the triple closure of generators added no point beyond the generators. So the semigroup is essentially trivial, and its holes are every other V point.
not_done: Five-fold closure not reached (three-fold already empty); the free_astra-0042 item's own move list does not exist in the repo, so COMPOSITION_ES Prop 1.2 was used instead; holes measured only in the scanned mu range.
next: Measure, over n=p, the fraction of mu in (sqrt p, 10 sqrt p] with V_p(mu) nonempty, to see whether the composition set is ever large.

summary: The Mordell hard set M={1,121,169,289,361,529} mod 840 equals the CRT product A8 x A3 x A5 x A7 (A8={1}, A3={1}, A5={1,4}, A7={1,2,4}), so for n_k=f(k) the visit density is delta(f)=prod_q N_q(f)/q; brute force over k mod 840 agrees on 3000 random quadratics (0 mismatches). Achievable per-prime values are {0,1/8,1/4,1/2,1}, {0,1/3,2/3,1}, {0,1/5,...,1}, {0,2/7,...,1}; delta(k^2+2)=0 (never 1 mod 3), and delta=1 only for functions constant on each prime-power component, so no non-constant quadratic is trapped in M.
not_done: Non-quadratic recurrences; the item's 'exact sufficient congruence pattern' was taken as the complement of M (Mordell's covering), not a smaller pattern; no effective (non-density) visit statement.
next: None needed: the complement of M is already covered, and the visit question reduces to the product-form density above.

summary: For every subset S of {8,3,5,7} the exclusion set {n=4k+1 : n mod q in A_q for q in S} was computed over its full period (density, longest cyclic run of excluded k, covering radius in k-steps). For S={8,3,5,7} (= M mod 840) the density is 6/210 and the longest run is 1 (no two consecutive hard n=1 mod 4), and the covering radius is 1 step (n to n+4); all subsets give run 1 except S={7} (run 2) and covering radius 1 throughout.
not_done: Gaps only in the k-progression (no prime-restricted gaps); only the moduli {8,3,5,7} subsets.
next: None needed unless a concrete search over good parameters is designed.

summary: On the same 8966 primes (p=1 mod 4, p<=2e5) the weighted mean of U/log^2 p moves by +8% under 1/tau(p-1) and -13% under 1/U(p). The R=0 ((*)-failure) rate for p<=3e6 is 0.00078 unweighted, 0.0033 under 1/U (x4.2, ESS 6055) and 0.00050 under 1/tau; the R=0 primes have U between 15 and 92 (409:15, 577:18, 5569:27, 9601:23, 23929:92), i.e. the enrichment is the low-U tail already noted in BRAINSTORM/z52b_fingerprint.md item 93, not a new invariant. The rare-witness observable U<=4 never occurs in this sample.
not_done: Only the mean of U/log^2 p and the R=0 rate; no weighted regression of the character fits; 1/tau(p-1) is one reading of 'reciprocal-divisor'.
next: Refit the lfit-style character regressions under the 1/U weight to check for sign changes.

summary: Toy encoding: left/right denominators with an edge (a,b) for each ordered coordinate pair of the ES solutions of 4/p (7 primes, 9-44 solutions each). Each edge determines the third denominator, and the maximum matching equals the number of distinct left denominators for all 7 primes (p=409: 34 of 34); a random-weight determinant is nonzero in every case. The matching/determinant encoding is saturated and reduces to the existence of a solution, adding no constraint.
not_done: No genuinely determinantal encoding with spurious-solution analysis, and no factor-allocation model with nontrivial constraints; only the coordinate-pair graph.
next: Skip unless a factor-allocation model with nontrivial constraints is specified.
